title: 第九章 直入绝阵第十章 影魔族影媚儿
content_zh:
在将夜行兽身上的阵法解除后，武书便是准备带着李剑锋前往巨象山脉深处。毕竟巨象山脉深处更适合修炼，这同时武书也想会会来犯的魔族子弟。最重要的是，在武书看来，进入法阵的魔族子弟，不说实力怎么样？身家肯定是不菲的。
武书现在急需提升实力，修炼资源却是匮乏的，而从魔族手中抢夺修炼资源，似乎更能满足武书的爽感。
总之，就是强行装，继续装下去。
一旁的李剑锋见武书想就此离开，看向追杀自己误入阵法的魔仆，李剑锋内心是挣扎的。这数名魔仆，可都是被魔族控制住的堃国天才后辈，若非有今日的遭遇，他日必定能在堃国有所作为。
“舒武兄，能否将这几位也带上。”
听到李剑锋的话，武书内心是十分吃惊的。武书只感觉，这什么情况？没看出来，带着你们前进，就已经是我的极限了吗？否则的话，是需要消耗灵石的啊？
武书也不多做解释，仅是装作狐疑的看向李剑锋。
李剑锋立马解释道，“舒武兄有所不知，这几位皆是我堃国天才后辈，若非遇到今次劫难，他日这几人，必定能成为堃国一方人物。”
在精神上，武书毕竟是过来人。
一想到将来，武书也觉得应该出手救下这几人。
又是想了想，武书道，“李兄，想救下这几人并不难，但是却要消耗一些下品灵石。不瞒李兄……”
能用灵石解决的问题，还算事吗？
况且，救下这几人，还只需要消耗一些下品灵石，区区下品灵石怎么能够与这几人性命相提并论。当然，若是下品灵石数量过多，李剑锋也是拿不出来的，他身上的下品灵石的数量也是有限的。
也是真担心，救下几人需要消耗大量下品灵石，李剑锋心都提到嗓子了试探道，“不知舒武兄需要多少下品灵石才能救下他们？”
……？
怎么看，这李剑锋都是头肥羊，这货身上似乎有不少灵石。
武书依旧没有说话，只是冲着李剑锋伸出一个手掌。而李剑锋一见武书只是伸出手掌，没有说出具体数字后，李剑锋有一种窒息的感觉。更是自我脑补不断，不会吧？想要救下他们，需要消耗这么多灵石吗？
五万？
五十万？
或者更多？

心惊之余，李剑锋诚心问道，“舒武兄，你这是？”
武书一副老气横秋的道，“李兄，想要救下这几位呢？换做那些绝世阵法大师前来，可能一块灵石都不需要消耗。可在下毕竟不是绝世阵法大师，若是要在下救助这几位，运气好的话，六七块灵石就可以刻出法阵，可若是运气差的话，没有三五十块下品灵石，怕是难以救下他们。”
李剑锋简直不敢相信自己的耳朵。
什么玩意？
只需要三五十块灵石？兄弟，能不能一口气把话说完。
一瞬间，李剑锋手中便是出现数十块灵石，李剑锋诚心道，“舒武兄，你看这些灵石够吗？”
出现在李剑锋手中的，赫然是数十块下品灵石和几块中品灵石。不得不说，李剑锋果真是头肥羊。
武书不由心中感慨。
接过灵石后，武书思索道，“给我一炷香时间。”
然后一人一虎一马，便是见武书盘地而坐，开始修炼起来。而武书却是不断在精神上与武左武右沟通，如“武左武右，这次算是给你们戴罪立功的机会，一炷香，一炷香内必须在二十块灵石上刻画出圣纹。
武左武右本以为武书此次想要救人，会让他们刻画的阵法，无非是些九牛随心阵之类的阵法，可万万没想到，这货一张口，就是要他二人在一炷香内刻画出这么多灵石圣纹。
这不是想将他们活活累死吗？
武左武右反问道，“那你干什么？”
content_en:
After removing the formation from the night beast, Wu Shu prepared to take Li Jianfeng to the depths of the Giant Elephant Mountains. After all, the depths of the Giant Elephant Mountains are more suitable for cultivation. At the same time, Wu Shu also thought about the demon children who might invade. The most important thing is, in Wu Shu's opinion, how about the demon disciples who enter the magic circle, not to mention their strength? The net worth must be quite high.
Wushu now urgently needs to improve his strength, but training resources are scarce, and snatching training resources from the demons seems to be more satisfying for Wushu.
In short, just force yourself to pretend and keep pretending.
Li Jianfeng on the side saw that Wu Shu wanted to leave and looked at the demon servant who was chasing him and accidentally entered the formation. Li Jianfeng was struggling in his heart. These demon servants are all talented descendants of the Kun Kingdom who were controlled by the demons. If they had not experienced what they experienced today, they would definitely be able to make a difference in the Kun Kingdom in the future.
"Brother Shu Wu, can you bring these guys with you?"
Wu Shu was very surprised when he heard Li Jianfeng's words. Wu Shu only felt, what is going on? Don’t you see that taking you forward is already my limit? Otherwise, do you need to consume spiritual stones?
Wu Shu didn't explain much, he just looked at Li Jianfeng pretending to be suspicious.
Li Jianfeng immediately explained, "Brother Shu Wu doesn't know that these are all talented descendants of our Kun country. If they had not encountered this disaster, these people would definitely become figures in the Kun country in the future."
Mentally, Wu Shu is a veteran after all.
When thinking about the future, Wu Shu also felt that he should save these people.
After thinking about it again, Wu Shu said, "Brother Li, it is not difficult to save these people, but it will consume some low-grade spiritual stones. To be honest, Brother Li..."
Is it still a problem that can be solved with spiritual stones?
Moreover, saving these people only requires the consumption of some low-grade spiritual stones. How can a mere low-grade spiritual stone be compared with the lives of these people. Of course, if there are too many low-grade spiritual stones, Li Jianfeng will not be able to get them out. The number of low-grade spiritual stones on his body is also limited.
He was really worried. It would take a lot of low-grade spiritual stones to save a few people. Li Jianfeng's heart was in his throat and he asked, "I wonder how many low-grade spiritual stones Brother Shu Wu will need to save them?"
...?
No matter how you look at it, Li Jianfeng is a fat sheep. He seems to have a lot of spiritual stones in his body.
Wu Shu still said nothing, but stretched out his palm towards Li Jianfeng. When Li Jianfeng saw Wu Shu just stretched out his palm without giving a specific number, Li Jianfeng felt suffocated. It’s just more self-inflicted, isn’t it? Do you need to consume so many spiritual stones to save them?
fifty thousand?
Half a million?
Or more?
While being frightened, Li Jianfeng asked sincerely, "Brother Shu Wu, what are you doing?"
Wu Shu said in an old-fashioned way, "Brother Li, do you want to save these people? If it were those peerless formation masters who came here, they might not need to consume a single spiritual stone. But after all, I am not a peerless formation master. If I want to rescue these few, if I am lucky, six or seven spiritual stones can carve out the magic circle. But if I am not lucky, I will not be able to save them without thirty or fifty low-grade spiritual stones."
Li Jianfeng couldn't believe his ears.
What the hell?
Only need thirty or fifty spiritual stones? Brother, can you finish the sentence in one breath?
In an instant, dozens of spiritual stones appeared in Li Jianfeng's hand. Li Jianfeng said sincerely, "Brother Shu Wu, do you think these spiritual stones are enough?"
What appeared in Li Jianfeng's hands were dozens of low-grade spiritual stones and several medium-grade spiritual stones. I have to say that Li Jianfeng is really a fat sheep.
Wu Shu couldn't help but sigh in his heart.
After receiving the spirit stone, Wu Shu thought, "Give me a stick of incense time."
Then, one person, one tiger and one horse, saw Wu Shu sitting cross-legged on the ground and began to practice. But Wu Shu constantly communicated with Wu Zuo and Wu You mentally, such as "Wu Zuo and Wu You, this is an opportunity for you to redeem yourself and make meritorious service. One stick of incense must be paid within 20 yuan of spirit."Sacred patterns are carved on the stone.
Wu Zuo and Wu You originally thought that when Wu Shu wanted to save people this time, the formations he would ask them to carve out were nothing more than some formations like the Nine Niu Suixin Formation, but they never expected that this fellow would ask them to carve out so many spiritual stone sacred patterns in a stick of incense.
Doesn't this mean to exhaust them to death?
Wu Zuo Wuyou asked, "Then what are you doing?"
